llm.note: LLM proposer implemented and fixture-tested; no API key, so it did not run

exp01_strategies.notes: Every strategy/budget/seed is identical across problems; winners are confirmed by 3 re-measurements.

exp02_ablation.notes: Same mutation proposer, budget and seeds; only the rendered feedback signal blocks differ.

exp03_cost_model.notes: Compiles-to-best counts build requests (one per trial) in the equal-budget exp01 runs, with cache misses reported separately; the oracle enumerates every legal variant for tasks with a small knob space.

exp04_reliability.notes: Timeout/retry counts come from a deliberate sleep probe; compile failures are counted over exp01 and a deliberate syntax error; rerun variance repeats the same strategy, seed and budget twice.
